summary: String methods clean up, search, slice, and split text. Each one returns a new string, so you save the result in a variable.
notes: course[1:4] includes index 1 and stops before index 4.
find() returns -1 when the text is not found. The in keyword returns True or False.
split(",") returns a list. " | ".join(names) is called on the separator, not on the list.
pitfall: Writing course.lower() on its own line does nothing visible. Strings are immutable, so you must write course = course.lower().
